q: What is the duration of the internship program?
a: Our standard internship is 1.5 months (6 weeks), project-based and fully hands-on. The Training + Internship track runs for 3 months including the initial training phase.

q: Is the internship remote or on-site?
a: We offer both remote and hybrid formats. Our physical office is located in Haripur, KPK. Students outside the region can participate fully online with the same mentorship and project work.
Upon successful completion, you will receive a verified M-Tech completion certificate, a project portfolio entry, and a LinkedIn recommendation from your mentor.

q: When does the next batch start?
a: Our Summer 2026 batch is open for applications and will begin in July 2026. Join our WhatsApp community to receive real-time updates on upcoming sessions.

q: What tracks are available for internship?
a: We currently offer internships in: Web Development, App Development, Cybersecurity, AI & Machine Learning, Digital Marketing, UI/UX Design, DevOps, and Blockchain.

q: Is there a fee for the internship?
a: The standalone internship is free for selected candidates. The Training + Internship combined program has a course fee which covers structured mentorship, resources, and certification.
Click the 'Apply Now' button on any page to fill out the registration form. Our team will review your application and contact you within 48 hours.

q: Can I join if I am a beginner?
a: Yes. We have programs designed for absolute beginners through to advanced-level students. Our mentors tailor the learning path based on your current skill level.
